title: CG Oncology Appoints Proven Biopharmaceutical Commercial Leader Isabel Kalofonos as Chief Commercial Officer
summary: CG Oncology Appoints Proven Biopharmaceutical Commercial Leader Isabel Kalofonos as Chief Commercial Officer
body_markdown:
DALLAS, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — CG Oncology, Inc. (NASDAQ: CGON) today announced the appointment of Isabel Kalofonos as Chief Commercial Officer. A highly accomplished biopharmaceutical executive with more than 20 years of commercial leadership experience, Ms. Kalofonos will lead the Company’s commercial strategy and execution as CG Oncology advances toward the potential launch of cretostimogene grenadenorepvec and continues to establish itself as a leader in bladder cancer.


“Isabel’s appointment reflects our commitment to ensuring we are well positioned to bring cretostimogene to as many patients as possible upon approval,” said Arthur Kuan, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of CG Oncology. “As we prepare for a potential first commercial launch, we are making deliberate investments in experienced leaders who have successfully built commercial organizations, developed differentiated strategies, and delivered product launches at scale. Isabel brings an outstanding track record of commercial execution across multiple therapeutic areas and stages of growth, and we are confident her expertise will be instrumental as we prepare to deliver on the full potential of cretostimogene.”


Ms. Kalofonos brings more than 20 years of experience driving successful launches and commercial execution, helping bring innovative therapies to patients at scale across the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industries. Most recently, she served as Chief Commercial Officer of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals (acquired by Vertex Pharmaceuticals), where she played a key role in the company’s transition to the commercial stage, helping to drive the successful launch of PALSONIFY™ (paltusotine) and advance commercial planning across the pipeline.


Prior to Crinetics, Ms. Kalofonos served as Chief Commercial Officer at ImmunoGen (acquired by AbbVie), where she led the successful launch of ELAHERE® (mirvetuximab soravtansine) in ovarian cancer. Earlier in her career, Ms. Kalofonos served as Senior Vice President and Global Head of the Prescription Business Unit at Galderma, where she oversaw the build-out of the business unit and pre-launch preparations for NEMLUVIO® (nemolizumab). She also served as Vice President and Head of the Hereditary Angioedema Franchise at Takeda Pharmaceuticals (formerly Shire), leading a multi-billion-dollar business and the successful global launch of TAKHZYRO® (lanadelumab‑flyo). Throughout her career, she has built and led high-performing global commercial organizations across oncology, immunology, rare diseases, and neurology. Ms. Kalofonos holds an M.B.A. in Entrepreneurship and Marketing from Babson College and a bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering from Pontificia Universidad Javeriana.


“CG Oncology is entering an exciting and transformative period, and I am thrilled to join the company at such a pivotal time,” said Isabel Kalofonos. “The clinical data generated to date for cretostimogene, the significant unmet need that remains for patients with bladder cancer, and the passion of the CG Oncology team make this a truly compelling opportunity. Having spent much of my career preparing companies for launch and building commercial organizations, I look forward to hitting the ground running, partnering across the organization, and helping ensure we are ready to successfully bring cretostimogene to patients.”


**About Cretostimogene Grenadenorepvec**
Cretostimogene is an investigational, intravesically delivered oncolytic immunotherapy that has been studied in a clinical development program, which includes more than 400 patients with Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC). This program includes two Phase 3 clinical trials: BOND-003 for high-risk BCG-unresponsive NMIBC and PIVOT-006 for intermediate-risk NMIBC. Cretostimogene has received FDA Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy designations. CG Oncology also has a Phase 2 trial, CORE-008, evaluating the safety and efficacy of cretostimogene in high-risk NMIBC. Additionally, we have initiated an Expanded Access Program for cretostimogene in North America for patients who are unresponsive to BCG and meet certain program eligibility requirements. Cretostimogene is an investigational candidate, and its safety and efficacy have not been established by the FDA or any other health authority.


**About CG Oncology**
CG Oncology is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing a potential backbone bladder-sparing therapeutic for patients afflicted with bladder cancer. CG Oncology sees a world where urologic cancer patients may benefit from our innovative immunotherapies to live with dignity and have an enhanced quality of life. To learn more, please visit: **[www.cgoncology.com](https://cgoncology.com/)** .
